entities.summary: Nebojša Rodić is a Serbian politician, lawyer and diplomat who currently serves as the Ambassador of Serbia to Austria. He served as the Minister of Defence of Serbia from 2 September 2013 to 27 April 2014 and as the Director of the Security Intelligence Agency from 3 August 2012 to 3 September 2013. He is a member of the Serbian Progressive Party. Nebojša Rodić was a journalists & chroniclers from Šabac (b. 1953, Šabac). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
